entries.3305c04a58642a75: The company's strengths lie in appraisal and inspection by staff with specialist knowledge in each business, called 'Experts', and in calculating appropriate purchase prices using its proprietary purchase valuation database. Second-hand goods the company purchases are refurbished using its own repair and cleaning know-how and then sold; through a circular model that combines trade-ins of second-hand goods with sales of new products, it encourages repeat use by customers. Each business has physical stores, and it discloses the condition of products transparently both on EC and in stores.

entries.b8c908e27e694fec: It is an EC retail company established in 2005 that handles specialist products in cameras, watches and writing instruments. It does not prepare consolidated financial statements, and as of March 31, 2026 had 260 employees. It is listed on the Prime Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
entries.b9e77ae8bc8824a1: Its growth pillars are strengthening its own EC site and expanding cross-border EC. In the Camera Business it has introduced 'AIMD', an automatic purchase and sales price-setting system using AI, and in the Watch Business it has introduced 'AI Support MD', a pricing support system, to strengthen its ability to respond to changes in product prices. In April 2026 it implemented a replacement of its core system and is strengthening its data utilization platform.
entries.bac4874b85c29977: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥51,924 million, and revenue from external customers was ¥40,734 million for the Camera Business, ¥10,399 million for the Watch Business, ¥479 million for the Writing Instruments Business and ¥311 million for the Bicycle Business.

entries.fdf060fe80cefe46: The EC penetration rate for goods sales in domestic retail sales is estimated at 9.78% in 2024, and in the second-hand goods market, the growth in consumer-to-consumer transactions through internet auctions and flea-market apps is driving market expansion. Japan accounts for over 90% of the company's revenue, and cross-border EC revenue is ¥3,231 million. The number of Web members stood at 786,251 as of March 31, 2026.
